desc:
💰 Open Dumpling Boxes and earn cash to buy even better Dumpling Boxes.

👥 Trade Instructions:
1. Stand on a trading board with another player/NPC.
2. Both players add the dumplings they want to trade.
3. Click the ✅ button at the same time to accept.
4. Click ❌ to cancel the trade.
5. Click ➕ to request more items before accepting.

✨ Can You Collect Every Dumpling?
Use the Index to collect all dumplings
